scan.name: Scan
scan.description: Processes a card that was held against a scan point.

uid.name: UID
uid.description: The chip UID the reader returned.

station.name: Scan point
station.description: Device name, name or short name of the scan point.

learn_card.description: Binds a card to a task or to a person. Without a UID the next unknown scan is taken.

uid.name: UID
uid.description: Leave empty to use the next scan, or the last unknown one.

person_id.name: Person
person_id.description: Alone this makes a status card. Together with a task it binds the card to that person only.

complete.name: Complete task
complete.description: Ticks a task off or takes it back.

routine_id.description: The routine the task belongs to.

select_person.name: Select person
select_person.description: Sets who is shown at a scan point.

station.name: Scan point
station.description: Device name, name or short name of the scan point.

person_id.name: Person
person_id.description: Leave empty to step through the people instead.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Which way to step when no person is given.

keepalive.name: Keep context alive
keepalive.description: Extends the active person at a scan point without changing anything.

station.name: Scan point
station.description: Device name, name or short name of the scan point.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Clears the progress of a routine.

routine_id.name: Routine
routine_id.description: Leave empty to reset every routine.

add_routine.name: Add routine
add_routine.description: Creates a routine. Returns its id.

name.name: Name
name.description: Shown in the app and on the routine's to-do lists.

window_start.name: Window start
window_start.description: The routine is shown from this time, and its progress is cleared here.

window_end.name: Window end
window_end.description: After this time the routine is no longer shown.

person_ids.name: People
person_ids.description: List of people this routine applies to.

weekdays.name: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Leave empty to run every day. The day a window starting before midnight belongs to is the day it opened.

remove_routine.name: Remove routine
remove_routine.description: Deletes a routine together with its tasks, cards and progress.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Appends a task to a routine. Returns its id.

label.name: Word
label.description: The word shown under the symbol.

icon.name: Icon name
icon.description: Pick from the list, or give a hex codepoint for an icon that is baked into your display font but not listed.

stations.name: Scan points
stations.description: Leave empty to make the task tickable everywhere.

weekdays.name: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Leave empty to run on every day the routine runs.

remove_task.name: Remove task
remove_task.description: Deletes a task together with its cards and progress.

routine_id.name: Routine
routine_id.description: The routine the task belongs to.

get_routines.name: Get routines
get_routines.description: Returns people, scan points, routines, tasks and cards with their ids.
